subject: EdgeLight: subcontractor transition for EU POPs — notice & evidence request
messages:
From: EdgeLight Operations <operations@edgelightcdn.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: subcontractor appointment for EU POPs (FastEdge)

Hi Naomi,

Quick heads up — EdgeLight will be onboarding a subcontractor (FastEdge, Ltd.) to operate a subset of our European POPs (Frankfurt, Amsterdam) starting 2025-09-01. This change is to improve latency for EU customers and to provide redundancy for our EU footprint.

Attached: subprocessor_roster_v1.csv (lists FastEdge and their role), and a short implementation timeline.

We realize this touches data residency and transfer questions. FastEdge will process cached content and diagnostic logs only; they will not retain raw customer payloads beyond 48 hours. FastEdge has indicated an independent SOC 2 Type II report (we are requesting the formal statement from them).

Please let us know what documentation you need for Redwood's DPA and any evidence pack you require. We aim to send a DocuSign amendment by 2025-08-20.

Thanks,
Alex Nguyen
Operations — EdgeLight CDN

---
Attachment: subprocessor_roster_v1.csv (CSV, 12 rows)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: EdgeLight Operations <operations@edgelightcdn.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: subcontractor appointment for EU POPs (FastEdge)

Alex — thanks for the notice and the roster. A few quick asks from our side so we can triage internally: 

1) Please confirm the precise data categories that FastEdge will process (e.g., only aggregate logs, edge cache fragments, or any identifiable request metadata).
2) Provide the SOC 2 Type II statement or at least a SOC 2 attestation letter for FastEdge.
3) Clarify geographic processing: will any of FastEdge's ops touch data outside the EU during troubleshooting (remote support in US)?
4) Share the proposed DPA amendment (DocuSign link when available) and the exact effective date.

Kimberly/Jordan/Neha — looping you in for legal and security review. From a compliance perspective, we need: impact assessment on EU residency, updated dataflow diagram for the affected POPs, encryption at rest/ingress guarantees, and evidence that FastEdge's personnel access is limited and logged.

Timeline: EdgeLight's stated go-live 2025-09-01. If DocuSign hits our inbox by 2025-08-20 with the requested artifacts, we can run an expedited review. Otherwise we'll need to hold the changes behind our fallback routing policy.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Inline: quoted subprocessor_roster_v1.csv referenced above.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: subcontractor appointment for EU POPs (FastEdge)

Thanks Naomi — quick internal checklist I propose before we respond formally to EdgeLight: 

- Confirm dataset scope: are any customer submission payloads (unencrypted) involved? If yes, require encryption-at-rest proof and key custody details.
- Request FastEdge SOC 2 Type II report (or at least a snapshot + statement of coverage).
- Verify contract language: subprocessors clause + vendor access controls + export control language + audit rights.
- Ask for updated dataflow diagram (SVG/PDF) showing processing boundaries and any cross-border remote admin paths.
- Require a 30-day rollback/fallback window in the amendment and a contact for incident escalation.

Jordan: can Legal prepare an expedited DPA amendment template we can send to EdgeLight (with DocuSign placeholders)?
Neha: Security — please list the minimum evidence set we need from FastEdge (e.g., AV logs, endpoint management, personnel background checks, admin access lists).

I'll draft the response and share a boilertemplate we can send to EdgeLight.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Privacy Contracts
Redwood Inference

---
No attachments.

From: legal@edgelightcdn.com <legal@edgelightcdn.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@edgelightcdn.com>, docusign+edgelight-1234@docusign.net
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: subcontractor appointment for EU POPs (FastEdge)

Hi Naomi/Kim — thanks for the quick turnaround. We appreciate the checklist. A few items: 

- Attached is our proposed DPA amendment draft (edgelight-dpa-amendment-draft-2025.pdf) and a pointer to the FastEdge SOC 2 statement (we will provide the full report under NDA if required).
- DocuSign envelope is prepared and will be sent to Redwood legal for signature: https://www.docusign.net/ENVELOPEID/abcd-ef12 (expected to arrive 2025-08-18).
- FastEdge confirms processing scope: cached HTTP fragments and operational logs. No raw customer payload storage beyond 48 hours, and all caches are encrypted at rest. They have a support channel that may reach US-based engineers for emergency debug; remote access is logged.

We are happy to include a 30-day rollback option in the amendment and to permit Redwood to schedule an on-site or virtual audit (within reason).

Best,
Monica Reed
Counsel — EdgeLight CDN

---
Attachment: edgelight-dpa-amendment-draft-2025.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: EdgeLight Operations <operations@edgelightcdn.com>, legal@edgelightcdn.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, fastedge-ops@fastedge.io
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: subcontractor appointment for EU POPs (FastEdge)

Thanks — received the draft amendment and the confirmation on scope. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) Jordan's team will review the DPA amendment and propose one tracked-change round by 2025-08-14.
2) Neha will publish the security evidence checklist (SOC snapshot, personnel access lists, encryption architecture notes) to your Drive folder by 2025-08-13.
3) EdgeLight to provide the SOC 2 letter or report (or provide NDA for us to accept the full report) by 2025-08-15.
4) We will not approve cutover before 2025-09-01 until the above items are complete; if DocuSign arrives earlier and the evidence is sufficient we'll move as agreed, otherwise we'll exercise fallback routing for impacted customers.

Please also (EdgeLight/FastEdge) confirm whether any diagnostic traces will include identifiable IP addresses beyond the 48-hour TTL. If yes we will require pseudonymization or stricter retention guarantees.

Naomi
Head of Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
